name: Soanin Vensil
source:
Imperial King of Calantia, the Atlantic Ocean Kingdom. Arrogant and rude to people he views unworthy of his attention, but valiantly dedicated to his people and is currently the only king dedicated to transitioning his kingdom from the war-mongering empire it once was. He’s grown up being told he has to be ruthless to people who’re below him (hence his distaste for humans who have a pretty bad rep as far as sea folk are concerned) but he genuinely wants the best for his people. Only has one redeeming quality--he really loves his brother.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=36495]Lemma Soft Forum[/url]]
